news.headline: Steelers place WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR with foot injury
news.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) on injured reserve, the team announced on Saturday.

news.headline: Bills rule out Ed Oliver, Joshua Palmer, wait on WR DJ Moore
news.description: Bills wide receiver DJ Moore returned to practice in a noncontact jersey and will be designated as questionable for "Monday Night Football" against the Rams. Buffalo has ruled out wide receiver Joshua Palmer and defensive tackle Ed Oliver.

news.headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among 5 Eagles ruled out vs. Jags
news.description: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, wide receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and wide receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.
